runs.prompt: Add a method Clear to Cart in cart/cart.go that removes every line, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Cart.Clear` in [cart/cart.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.intent.go-shop.T12.1/run-01/repo/cart/cart.go). It removes every line. [TestClear](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.intent.go-shop.T12.1/run-01/repo/cart/cart_test.go) covers a populated cart, an empty cart, and adding a line afterward.

runs.finalMessage:

`TestPreview`, `TestPlaceOrder`, and `TestPlaceOrderNeedsSession` passed. The full `go test ./...` suite passed.

Added draft trace item `R-SESSION-LOGOUT`; the change keeps it true. `go test ./accounts` passes, including `TestLogout`. No risk or threat control item was changed.

runs.prompt: Add a method Expired to Discount in pricing/discount.go that reports whether the code has expired at a given time, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Discount.Expired(now)`, which returns true at or after the discount’s expiry time. The new test covers times before, exactly at, and after expiry.

Added draft trace item `R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRED-CHECK`, linked to the method and `TestDiscountExpired`. The change keeps that item true and preserves its parent item, `R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRY`. Neither item controls a risk or threat. `go test ./pricing` passed, including `TestDiscountExpired` and the existing `TestApplyDiscount/rejects_expired`.
